arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test that +0100 and +01:00 produce equal FixedTzOffset objects
fmt = 'a {:ti} b'
result_0100 = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b')
result_01_00 = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+01:00 b')

dt_0100 = result_0100[0]
dt_01_00 = result_01_00[0]

print(f'Result +0100 datetime: {dt_0100}')
print(f'Result +01:00 datetime: {dt_01_00}')
print(f'tzinfo +0100: {dt_0100.tzinfo}')
print(f'tzinfo +01:00: {dt_01_00.tzinfo}')
print(f'Equal? {dt_0100.tzinfo == dt_01_00.tzinfo}')
print(f'Name +0100: {dt_0100.tzinfo._name}')
print(f'Name +01:00: {dt_01_00.tzinfo._name}')

# Also test with leading space (like in RFC2822 format)
result_space = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20 +0100 b')
print(f'Result +space+0100 name: {result_space[0].tzinfo._name}')

# Test single digit hour
result_single = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+1:00 b')
print(f'Result +1:00 name: {result_single[0].tzinfo._name}')
"
